title: Known Science and Physical Principles: Adaptive Buildings — Signature Edition
description: Engineering record for Adaptive Buildings (Transportation and Future Cities). Sets out the established scientific foundation: what is known, what the governing principles are, and where settled science ends and open questions begin.
body:
This record sets out the established scientific foundation: what is known, what the governing principles are, and where settled science ends and open questions begin. It covers Adaptive Buildings — Structures that adjust shading, ventilation, energy use, and selected physical properties to environmental conditions.

Transport technology is in a deployment phase for autonomy on roads and an R&D phase for autonomy in the air. High-speed ground concepts fight economics more than physics; electric aviation fights battery energy density; cities-as-systems fight institutional inertia. The demonstrated wins — driver assistance, metro automation, eVTOL test flights — are real and compounding. The speculative layer (supersonic point-to-point, floating cities, vacuum-tube intercity) needs honest cost-per-passenger-kilometer math before anything else.

Feasibility tier: DEMONSTRATED. Working systems exist and have been shown under real conditions; what remains is scaling, cost reduction, and broader deployment — not proof of possibility. Records at this tier document what has actually been shown, with evidence, rather than what is hoped.

The established science behind Adaptive Buildings rests on Transport is applied energy and control: drag, rolling resistance, and propulsion efficiency set energy use; network theory and control set throughput and safety. At the demonstrated feasibility tier, the honest statement is this: the governing principles are well understood and repeatedly exercised in working systems.
